design_decisions: Preserve current approved Orchestra glass/photo identity over synthetic state renders.
Use exact official HuGR symbol assets, 32px symbol, 30px avatar, 40x34px rail controls, 20px glyphs and logical 2px selection marker.
Use 230px / 208px / 56px widths at the contract breakpoints; below 1024px expose the rail on demand from a non-draggable titlebar control; retain existing mobile below 768px.
Persist explicit choice through existing desktop window storage, with sessionStorage for browser windows. Responsive constraints do not overwrite the choice.
Compose existing Kobalte tooltip and dropdown primitives with the actual keyboard target. English typed copy, no new translations.
Reuse existing route, profile and session APIs; no provider-tree remount, new backend, scheduler, or fake runtime controls.
